intro: The Crispy Falafel Pita is a standout vegetarian option on the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas), featuring perfectly seasoned crispy falafel nestled in warm pita bread. Priced at $11.45 to $12.45, this Mediterranean-inspired wrap combines traditional ingredients like hummus, fresh vegetables, and tangy lemon herb tahini. With 750 calories and 22g of protein, it delivers a satisfying plant-based meal that does not compromise on flavor or nutrition.
priceCalories: The Crispy Falafel Pita costs between $11.45 and $12.45 depending on your location, making it one of the most affordable options compared to other items on the [full CAVA menu](/). At 750 calories, it provides a filling meal with balanced macros including 22g protein, 82g carbs, and 38g fat. This price point offers excellent value for a complete, restaurant-quality Mediterranean pita wrap.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this pita apart is the combination of crispy, herb-infused falafel with creamy hummus and the signature lemon herb tahini dressing. The texture contrast between crunchy falafel, fresh vegetables, and soft pita bread creates a memorable eating experience. Unlike generic falafel wraps, CAVA uses premium ingredients and their house-made spreads found on the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) to elevate every bite.
nutritionFacts: Each Crispy Falafel Pita contains 750 calories with a balanced macro profile of 22g protein, 82g carbohydrates, and 38g fat. The protein comes primarily from chickpea-based falafel and tahini, making this a substantial plant-based option. The carbs provide sustained energy while the healthy fats from tahini and falafel support satiety. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) for personalized nutritional information based on customizations.
whatsInside: This curated pita features warm pita bread filled with crispy falafel, creamy hummus, fresh tomato and cucumber, tangy pickled onions, and shredded romaine lettuce. The lemon herb tahini dressing ties everything together with bright, herby flavors. Each ingredient is carefully selected to complement the others, creating a harmonious blend of Mediterranean flavors and textures that represent the best of CAVA's ingredient selection.
tasteLike: The Crispy Falafel Pita delivers a vibrant Mediterranean flavor profile with earthy, herb-forward notes from the falafel and bright citrus from the lemon tahini. The creamy hummus adds richness, while pickled onions provide a tangy punch that cuts through the richness. Fresh vegetables add crunch and lightness, creating a well-balanced taste experience that is both comforting and refreshing with every bite.
customize: While the Crispy Falafel Pita comes expertly curated, you can personalize it by exploring options from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/toppings) or [CAVA Dressings Menu](/dressings). Add extra vegetables for more crunch, swap in different spreads, or include additional protein options. Consider adding spicy harissa for heat or extra tahini for creaminess. The pita bread can also be swapped for alternative bases available on the menu.
pairsWell: This falafel pita pairs perfectly with items from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/sides) like crispy pita chips or a fresh seasonal salad. For beverages, consider a refreshing lemonade or sparkling water from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/drinks). The Greek Chicken Pita and other options on the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) make excellent companions for sharing and sampling different Mediterranean flavors in one meal.
healthyChoice: The Crispy Falafel Pita is an excellent plant-based option packed with fiber, protein, and nutrients from whole food ingredients. Chickpea-based falafel provides quality plant protein and complex carbohydrates for sustained energy. Fresh vegetables add vitamins and minerals, while tahini contributes healthy fats and calcium. At 750 calories with 22g protein, it is a nutritionally complete meal that supports various dietary preferences without sacrificing satisfaction.
howToOrder: Order the Crispy Falafel Pita directly from the curated pitas section at any CAVA location or through their app and website. Simply ask for the Crispy Falafel Pita by name, and it comes pre-configured with all signature ingredients. You can request modifications at the time of ordering. Visit [CAVA Locations](/locations) to find your nearest restaurant, or browse the complete menu online to plan your order ahead.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Greek Chicken Pita at 720 calories or the Garlic Chicken + Veggie Pita at 680 calories, the Crispy Falafel Pita offers a satisfying plant-based alternative with competitive nutrition. While the Spicy Chicken + Avocado Pita has 930 calories and the Steak + Feta Pita contains 820 calories, this falafel option provides the best value at $11.45 to $12.45 with excellent flavor and nutrition balance.
whoShouldTry: This pita is perfect for vegetarians, vegans seeking plant-based protein, and anyone exploring Mediterranean cuisine. Health-conscious diners looking for balanced nutrition without meat will appreciate the satisfying combination of falafel and fresh ingredients. It is also ideal for those with dietary restrictions, as falafel is naturally dairy-free. Anyone wanting authentic Mediterranean flavors at an accessible price point should definitely try this curated option.
worthTrying: The Crispy Falafel Pita absolutely deserves a spot on your CAVA must-try list. It showcases the restaurant's commitment to quality Mediterranean ingredients and balanced flavor profiles at an accessible price. With its satisfying combination of textures, vibrant flavors, and solid nutritional profile, this pita delivers exceptional value. Whether you are a longtime vegetarian or simply exploring plant-based options, this expertly curated wrap will not disappoint.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the Crispy Falafel Pita?
faqs.a: The Crispy Falafel Pita contains 750 calories with 22g protein, 82g carbohydrates, and 38g fat. This makes it a moderately caloric, balanced meal option suitable for lunch or dinner.

faqs.q: Is the Crispy Falafel Pita vegan?
faqs.a: Yes, the Crispy Falafel Pita is completely vegan as it contains no animal products. All ingredients including falafel, hummus, vegetables, and lemon herb tahini are plant-based, making it perfect for vegan diets.

faqs.q: How much does the Crispy Falafel Pita cost?
faqs.a: The Crispy Falafel Pita is priced between $11.45 and $12.45 depending on your location. This makes it one of the most affordable curated pita options on the CAVA menu.

faqs.q: Can I customize the Crispy Falafel Pita?
faqs.a: Yes, you can customize the Crispy Falafel Pita by adding or removing ingredients, swapping dressings, or adding extra toppings. CAVA allows modifications to all curated items to match your preferences and dietary needs.

CAVA's falafel achieves its signature crispy texture through expert preparation and cooking techniques. The herb-seasoned chickpea mixture is formed and cooked to create a golden, crunchy exterior while maintaining a tender, flavorful interior.
